title: Zero-minimum GROVE reward sale can be sandwiched
attacker_controlled_source: Public-mempool ordering and permissionless GROVE/USDC trading around an authorized report in direct-swap mode.
closest_control: No quote, TWAP, price-impact bound, or nonzero minimum output constrains execution.
sink: _swapFrom(REWARDS_TOKEN, base, toSwap, 0) forwards zero as amountOutMinimum.
impact: MEV extraction of accumulated reward value reduces depositor yield.

title: Primary APR path trusts a manipulable V3 current-state quote
attacker_controlled_source: Permissionless V3 trades and temporary liquidity control the instantaneous state observed by the oracle.
closest_control: Current liquidity, raw USDC balance, and a final APR cap do not provide a TWAP or independent-source check.
sink: The first positive V3 simulation is accepted and annualized before V4 fallback.
impact: A downstream allocator can misallocate or revert on manipulated APR.

title: V4 fallback accepts mutable spot pricing without a trustworthy quorum
attacker_controlled_source: Permissionless V4 spot trading controls current pool prices; unavailable siblings or supported small configurations can leave one/few quotes.
closest_control: A raw-liquidity threshold and current-median filter lack a minimum trustworthy quorum, TWAP, independent source, or value-depth check.
sink: A single mutable quote can pass as its own median and become the fallback APR price.
impact: Fallback APR can be biased or denied, subject to fallback and consumer-action preconditions.

title: Unbounded V3 tick traversal can exhaust gas before fallback
attacker_controlled_source: Permissionless V3 LP/trader activity controls price, liquidity, and initialized tick topology.
closest_control: No iteration, complexity, bounded-price, or subcall-gas control constrains traversal; try/catch does not isolate gas.
sink: Repeated bitmap/tick reads consume transaction gas before V4 fallback.
impact: APR-dependent transactions may revert and remain unavailable.

title: APR remains nonzero at the exact reward-expiry timestamp
attacker_controlled_source: Block timestamp exactly equals reward period finish.
sink: Annualization of a stored reward rate at zero remaining duration.
impact: Transient stale APR may misrank or misallocate capital.

title: Late deposits can dilute unreported accrued reward value
attacker_controlled_source: Open-mode or allowlisted depositor enters after reward accrual but before realization.
closest_control: Health checks and profit locking do not reserve pre-existing unreported reward value for pre-existing shares.
sink: Pending reward value is excluded from share-price assets until a later report distributes proceeds over the enlarged share base.
impact: Dilution and capture of incumbent reward yield.

title: Same-block staking supply changes can manipulate the APR denominator
attacker_controlled_source: Permissionless staking and withdrawal can temporarily change the live global staking supply around an APR-dependent transaction.
closest_control: Only the allocator-provided strategy delta is normalized; unrelated same-block supply changes are neither snapshotted nor averaged.
sink: Instantaneous staking totalSupply is used as the APR denominator.
impact: Temporary APR suppression or inflation may deny or misdirect downstream allocation.

title: Active reward auction can make later strategy reports revert
attacker_controlled_source: A prior report leaves the reward-token auction active while new rewards above threshold accrue before another report.
closest_control: The strategy does not check token-auction activity before transferring rewards and calling kick.
sink: The pinned auction rejects a kick for an already-active token auction, reverting the report atomically.
impact: Temporary unavailability of keeper reports, reward recognition, and maintenance until the auction becomes inactive.

title: Oversized exact-input quote is reinterpreted as exact-output mode
attacker_controlled_source: A downstream caller supplies amountIn at or above 2^255 to the exported quote API.
closest_control: No signed-range check precedes the uint256-to-int256 conversion.
sink: Negative converted value selects exact-output simulation semantics.
impact: A downstream integration can receive a semantically invalid quote or revert.
